description: This file implements the 'rebase_path' function for GN build scripts, handling path rebasing and conversion between relative, absolute, and source paths within the build system.

methods.name: MakeSlashEndingMatchInput
methods.description: Ensures the output path ends with a slash if the input path ends with a slash, matching the input's slash style.

methods.name: ValueLooksLikeDir
methods.description: Determines if a string value appears to be a directory based on its ending characters.

methods.name: AddCallLocationToError
methods.description: Attaches the location of the call site to an error for better diagnostics.

methods.name: ConvertOnePath
methods.description: Converts a single path value to a different base or format, handling directory and file paths.

methods.name: RunRebasePath
methods.description: Main function that processes arguments to rebase paths, supporting both string and list inputs, and handles path conversion logic.
